public_material_format.reference: $case_material_ref paths are relative to the containing file. Resolve the JSON Pointer, recursively expand, then verify the SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON: sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False.
public_material_format.source_identifiers: Native logical paths, hashes and embedded native references identify exact private sources, not public navigation. Source SHA mappings in this index locate their published projections. Reader navigation uses canonical public paths.
public_material_format.scope: One current selected dataset. Earlier selections remain in immutable private archives and the recorded Git revision, not parallel public history datasets.

density_policy_derivations.scope: New offline density reports; original factual sources, receipts and prior acceptance remain unchanged.
